ENV = dict(os.environ, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="us-west-2", AWS_REGION="us-west-2", AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="1", AWS_PAGER="")

assert identity["Account"] == "000000000000", "Unexpected account"
exported = subprocess.run(["aws", "configure", "export-credentials", "--format", "process"], env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
credential_data = json.loads(exported.stdout)
credentials = Credentials(credential_data["AccessKeyId"], credential_data["SecretAccessKey"], credential_data.get("SessionToken"))
del exported, credential_data
region = "us-west-2"

No credentials or request authorization retained.","retention":"Read-only query of existing owned traces; no new resources."}
def sample_call(label, inputs):
    url = "https://xray." + region + ".amazonaws.com/TraceSummaries"
    body = json.dumps(inputs, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    req = AWSRequest(method="POST", url=url, data=body, headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
    SigV4Auth(credentials, "xray", region).add_auth(req)
    started = int(time.time()*1000)
    try:
        response = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=dict(req.headers), method="POST"), timeout=30)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        response = error
    with response:
        raw = response.read().decode()
        status = response.status
        headers = dict(response.headers)
    output = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
    code = "Success" if status < 300 else headers.get("x-amzn-ErrorType", headers.get("x-amzn-errortype", output.get("__type", "UnmodeledError"))).split(":")[0].split("#")[-1]
    fixture["observations"].append({"label":label,"service":"xray","operation":"get-trace-summaries","region":region,"caller_account":identity["Account"],"actor_arn":identity["Arn"],"input":inputs,"request_started_ms":started,"response_observed_ms":int(time.time()*1000),"result":{"code":code,"http_status":status,"output":output},"raw_response_body":raw,"raw_response_headers":headers})
    print(label,status,code,len(output.get("TraceSummaries") or []),output.get("TracesProcessedCount"),output.get("Message",output.get("message","")))
window = dict(next(o["input"] for o in original["observations"] if o["label"] == "v2-summaries-poll-0"))
window.pop("Sampling", None)
